# Irving & Lavendar Lewis

- [Irving](../character/irving.md) — Romantically involved with — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — former lovers/reuniting suitors · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- [Irving](../character/irving.md) — Spouse of — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — to be married · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during a winter storm, where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) reveals the backstory of her failed engagement to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a affectionate bond.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
